text.description_html:
First Impressions SD-3226/15-US26 15 Inch Modern Square Shower Door Pulls

Very modern designed 15" glass shower door pulls made of 1" square brass with a polished chrome finish by First Impressions, a leader manufacture in door pulls.

  • Total Length: 15"
  • Mounting Centers: 10" C/C
  • Diameter: 1" Square
  • Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Material: Polished Chrome over Brass

Note: These modern shower door pulls are handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 4 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with 2 door pull handles and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
